content: Emitted the C5/C7 L1 runtime-exec twins in thermite-lower::l1::emit_string_runtime_l1: C5 family occurs_at/contains_sub/count_sep/sep_free (gated on program_uses_string_search) + C7 family is_digit/all_digits/free parse_u64/parse_be (gated on program_uses_parse, parse_be deduped vs the C4 numfmt round-trip). lower_expr_exec's Call arm .clone()s the leading string args (string_arg_count_l1) to handle the by-value/&-snapshot ambiguity uniformly. The 2 pinned tests flipped to assert build success. Gauntlet: cargo build workspace OK; cargo test --workspace 192 passed/0 failed; clippy -D warnings clean; fmt --check clean.
